description: Same calculations as the fixed-income page. Supply actual dated positive cash flows including redemption, settlement, currency, and either total outlay (clean price + accrued interest + fees) or annual-effective yield as a fraction. Returns price, annual-effective ACT/365F IRR, Macaulay and modified duration, convexity, DV01, maturity and repricing scenarios. Or select one of the 10 published bond ETFs to read N-PORT exposures and reported curve risks; coupon is not yield. No quota consumed, nothing stored, no advice. Search/fetch clients: bond: settlement=2026-11-04; currency=EUR; price=100; 2027-11-04=105. ETF example: bond: etf=TLT; country=US; haircut=0.1
